title: Love & Healthy Relationships
intro: A baby learns what love is from how they are answered. Long before words, they are working out whether crying brings comfort and whether faces light up when they arrive. This month is as much a prayer for the parents as a declaration over the child, because in the first year the two are almost the same thing.

keyScriptures.text: We love because he first loved us.
Love is patient, love is kind.

weeks.title: Answered
weeks.declaration: When you call, you are answered. That is the first thing love teaches, and you are learning it now.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give us the patience to keep answering. Let our child learn from us that calling out is safe. Amen.

weeks.title: Held Gently
weeks.declaration: You are handled gently. The hands that hold you are careful with you, and they always will be.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make our hands gentle when we are exhausted. Guard this child from our worst moments. Amen.

weeks.title: Faces That Light Up
weeks.declaration: People are glad to see you. That gladness is not something you have to earn by being good.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, let our faces be glad when this child comes into the room, this year and every year. Amen.

weeks.title: Learning Love from Being Loved
weeks.declaration: You will love people one day because you were loved first. This is where that begins.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, let the love in this house be the pattern our child carries out into the world. Amen.

days.title: Answered When You Call
days.declaration: When you cry, someone comes. That is the first thing you are learning about love.

scripture.text: His ears are attentive to their cry.

days.title: Love Came First
days.declaration: Love came to you before you could give any back. It started with someone else.

scripture.text: We love because he first loved us.

days.title: Held Gently
days.declaration: You are held gently. The hands around you are careful with you.

scripture.text: He gathers the lambs in his arms.

days.title: Patient with You
days.declaration: Love is patient, and you are being loved patiently while you learn everything at once.

scripture.text: Love is patient, love is kind.

days.title: Glad Faces
days.declaration: People light up when they see you. You do not have to earn that.

scripture.text: The Lord make his face shine on you.

days.title: Fed and Kept
days.declaration: You are fed, kept warm and kept close. Love is mostly ordinary work done again and again.

scripture.text: We were like young children among you... like a nursing mother cares for her children.

days.title: Not Too Much
days.declaration: You are not too much. Your needs are not an inconvenience; they are why we are here.

scripture.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened.

days.title: Comforted
days.declaration: When you are frightened, you are comforted. You will learn to trust that.

scripture.text: As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you.

days.title: Known Voices
days.declaration: You are learning the voices that love you. They will be familiar all your life.

scripture.text: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

days.title: Loved When Difficult
days.declaration: You are loved on the nights when nothing helps. That is when it counts.

scripture.text: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

days.title: Kindness Around You
days.declaration: The kindness around you is teaching you how to be kind. You are learning it by being given it.

scripture.text: Be kind and compassionate to one another.

days.title: Safe to Need
days.declaration: It is safe to need things here. You will never be shamed for needing.

scripture.text: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you.

days.title: A Family, Not Just Parents
days.declaration: You have more people than you know. There is a whole family learning your face.

scripture.text: God sets the lonely in families.

days.title: Love That Stays
days.declaration: The love around you is not going anywhere. It is not a mood; it is a decision.

scripture.text: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

days.title: Touch and Nearness
days.declaration: Being held is not a luxury. It is how you learn that the world is safe.

scripture.text: He took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.

days.title: Forgiven Before You Sin
days.declaration: You will be forgiven long before you understand what forgiveness is. It is in the walls here.

scripture.text: Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

days.title: Not Compared
days.declaration: You are not being measured against anyone. Your growing is your own.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions.

days.title: Watched Over While You Sleep
days.declaration: You are watched over while you sleep by someone who never needs to.

scripture.text: He who watches over you will not slumber.

days.title: Sung To
days.declaration: You are sung over. There is music in this house because you are in it.

scripture.text: He will rejoice over you with singing.

days.title: Spoken To
days.declaration: You are spoken to, not just about. Your presence changes the conversation.

scripture.text: Talk about them when you sit at home.

days.title: Learning Trust
days.declaration: Every time you are answered, trust grows. That trust will hold up a whole life.

scripture.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart.

days.title: Loved by God First
days.declaration: Before we loved you, God did. Our love is a small copy of a much bigger one.

scripture.text: See what great love the Father has lavished on us.

days.title: Room Made for You
days.declaration: Room was made for you before you came. Nothing had to be taken from anyone to make it.

scripture.text: My Father's house has many rooms.

days.title: Gentle Words
days.declaration: The words spoken over you are gentle. You will hear their tone long before their meaning.

scripture.text: Gracious words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul.

days.title: Steady, Not Perfect
days.declaration: The love around you is steady rather than perfect. Steady is what you actually need.

scripture.text: His love endures forever.

days.title: Cared For by Many
days.declaration: Other people will love you too — grandparents, friends, whole rooms of people. Love is not scarce.

scripture.text: They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts.

days.title: Held Through Change
days.declaration: Everything about you is changing fast, and you are held through all of it.

scripture.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

days.title: Loved, Not Owned
days.declaration: You are loved, not owned. You are being raised to be free, not to be kept.

scripture.text: Children are like arrows in the hands of a warrior.

days.title: A Whole Person Already
days.declaration: You are a whole person now, not a person in progress. Loved as you are today.

scripture.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body.

days.title: Practising on Us
days.declaration: You will practise loving on us first, and we can take it. That is what we are for.

scripture.text: When I was a child, I talked like a child.

days.title: Love Never Fails
days.declaration: Everything else about this year will change. This will not.

scripture.text: Love never fails.
